author: CBR
description:
Tim McDonald breaks down why the Split ending reveal is such a huge moment for superhero movies. He explains how M. Night Shyamalan connects Split to Unbreakable, why that twist reframes the full trilogy, and why some fans argue Unbreakable, Split, and Glass work better as a superhero trilogy than the MCU. 

If you love M. Night Shyamalan, Split, Unbreakable, Glass, and superhero movie debates, this changes the whole conversation.
